# ADR 0015: Commercial documents generated by Skout; signatures delegated to an e-sign provider

## Status
Proposed — pending Aditya review. Author: open (epic open question 7). E-sign provider: open
(epic open question 4).

## Context
Proposals, MSAs and order forms need consistent templates and immutable sent versions. Legally
binding signatures need an accepted provider with audit trails. Bible v2 Part IV states Skout
generates the documents and delegates signature initially.

## Decision
1. Skout generates proposals and contract documents from approved templates and stores every sent
   version immutably with a file hash.
2. Signature collection is delegated to an e-sign provider. Skout stores the envelope reference and
   the provider-reported status (sent, viewed, signed, declined, expired).
3. Phase 1 (COPS-03) records status manually where no provider is connected. The provider adapter
   replaces manual status in COPS-08.
4. Sent versions are never mutated; edits create a new version.

## Consequences
- Hash checks detect mutation of sent documents (COPS-03 acceptance criterion).
- Signature state is provider-derived; webhook handling must tolerate out-of-order delivery.
- Choosing the e-sign provider is a COPS-08 decision and does not block COPS-01.
